bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'USERBOT_SERVICE='; systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
printf 'BOT_CONTAINERS='; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E 'gaybbs|deploy-gaybbs' || true
container="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E 'gaybbs|deploy-gaybbs' | head -n1 || true)"
if [ -n "$container" ]; then
 docker inspect -f 'GAYBBS_RUNNING={{.State.Running}} IMAGE={{.Image}}' "$container"
 docker inspect "$container" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | awk -F= '$1=="GAYBBS_USERBOT_REPORT_CHAT_ID"{print "REPORT_DESTINATION_CONFIGURED=yes"; found=1} END{if(!found)print "REPORT_DESTINATION_CONFIGURED=no"}'
fi
printf 'TARGET_BRANCH_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'REPORT_SOURCE_BRANCH='; git show-ref --verify refs/remotes/origin/chat/bug-report-userbot-20261115 >/dev/null && echo exists || echo not_fetched
